business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- CIL operates a resilient two-vertical portfolio - Trading of Goods & Appliances, and Liquor Manufacturing & Distribution - under the Comfort Group led by Promoter Ankur Agrawal, building on the legacy of Founder & CEO Anil Agrawal.
- Corporate structure comprises one subsidiary, Liquors India Limited (65.3% stake), and two associate companies, Comfort Securities Limited (40.8%) and Lemonade Share & Securities Private Limited (46.8%).

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisition] Strategic acquisition of Liquors India Limited (Hyderabad) marked a step toward backward integration in the liquor value chain.
- [Corporate History] Originally incorporated as Comfort Finvest Limited on October 17, 1994; renamed Comfort Intech Limited with a fresh Certificate of Incorporation on March 24, 2000.
